integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, one continuous shot. A bronze statue of a seated man on a stone plinth in a sunlit public garden, a red brick wall with ivy, tall cypress trees and a white gazebo behind it. The camera travels in a slow, steady orbit around the statue, arcing to the right at a constant speed and keeping the statue centered, so the brick wall, the cypresses, the gazebo and the garden behind it sweep past and change with the angle. Warm late-afternoon sunlight, leaves stirring gently in a light breeze.

overall_soundscape: Outdoor garden ambience: light breeze in the leaves, distant birdsong, faint far-off traffic.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, one continuous shot. A woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length dark hair, in a long olive coat, walks toward the camera down a quiet cobblestone street at golden hour, slow and steady, glancing up at the lamps and along the shopfronts. The woman (S1), a warm, low female alto voice, calm and unhurried, speaks quietly as she walks. The camera holds a steady medium shot at eye level, keeping pace with her as she walks.

overall_soundscape: Soft footsteps on cobblestones, a faint breeze, distant street ambience.

non_diegetic_music: None.
